nodes.text: Okay. Tonight I finish this bad boy of a story for school up. I'm going to work until it done.
How about that? I'm prepared for an all nighter. So long as the words flow, I'll be fine.
Got to see some fine folk yesterday. The Smitjol, Mansleeve, and Dave Addison. I crashed on D.A.s couch, the strains of Lost lulling me to sleep.
I also got pulled over by a cop for running a red light. I suck. I ran that red light, totally unaware.
Maybe he was making it up, but I don't think so. I just said was in a daze and apologized. I think I can take defensive driving to make it go away.

I've had several strange dreams. I'm trying to remember last night's. The night before, was a keystone dream and unlocked several others from my past, allowing me to remember a big giant section of dream time narrative.

This dream was what I now dub my "nightmare nautical sci-fi wasteland". In this dream, I'll only highlight the current bits, not all the backstory. I was leading a group of scuba divers through this hellish stretch of ocean going vessel graveyard.

Rusted, run aground cruiseliners in a bleak bit of Caribbean keys. The horrific bit was we were being prodded by a massive sea turtle that kept breaching the surface, staring at us, and perhaps eating a few of us. It was unclear, or maybe something else was.
This thing was monstrous. The head was the size of trailer home. We were swimming for our lives.
Okay. I need to write now. Must.
okay. update from the day after. i've finished the story bit of it.
just like i said i would. the rest of the project is almost done as well. lots of work i'm doing on that.
the graphic design is all done, basically. i just need some flava text. i'll post a pdf of it, and the text of the story, when i'm all done.
maybe tomorrow. i need to have it finished by monday, regardless.
Another day. Sunday now. About to run off to work.
Just finished the rough of weep. You can read it here or wait until i get you a better looking hard copy sometime this week.
